title: AION 2 Chanter: Starter Build and Mantras
description: Prepare Chanter mantras, Dark Crush timing, and support swaps for parties with or without a Cleric.
summary: Build a working melee support setup, prioritize useful mantras, and change damage or recovery options to fit your party and unlocked skills.
quickAnswer: Chanter uses a staff for melee damage and party support. Spinning Strike and Impactful Crush open Dark Crush; Marchutan’s Wrath and Ensnaring Mark add Stigma triggers. Keep Recuperation separate: it heals and removes one debuff before specialization.

toc.title: Role and reasons to choose it

workflow.title: Practice one Dark Crush window
workflow.caption: Use one Dark Crush trigger, follow up, and fill the cooldown with ordinary attacks.

steps.label: Read the trigger
steps.description: Check the selected Dark Crush option and the condition that makes the follow-up available.

steps.label: Test one opening attack
steps.description: Use an opening such as Rushing Smash and watch for the follow-up opportunity.

steps.label: Use the available follow-up
steps.description: Use Dark Crush while available, then wait for the next trigger and cooldown.

steps.label: Fill the gap and react
steps.description: Use ordinary attacks while waiting; interrupt the loop for movement, healing, or protection.
